# PROMPT.md — Beat Signature Dataset Generator

## Objective

Build a CLI tool at `src/music_generation/generate_dataset.py` that generates synthetic conducting gesture datasets from `.wav` files. It pairs mel spectrograms with procedurally generated conducting keypoint sequences aligned to detected beats, outputting TFRecords compatible with the existing body-point-module pipeline.

beat_analyzer.py implemented and verified. BeatNet wrapper with BeatInfo dataclass, numpy/madmom compat patches, time_signature_override support. 4 tasks remaining.
conducting_patterns.py implemented: PATTERNS for 6 time sigs, CubicSpline interpolation, VariationParams, PatternGenerator. Verified ictus alignment, determinism, edge cases. 3 tasks remaining.

skeleton_builder.py implemented: SkeletonBuilder expands wrist trajectory to 17-joint MoveNet skeleton with IK elbows, mirrored arms, downbeat nod, static lower body. 2 tasks remaining: dataset_writer.py and generate_dataset.py.
dataset_writer.py implemented: TFRecord write/read for paired mel/keypoint samples with metadata. 1 task remaining: generate_dataset.py CLI entry point.
